values.note: City of Kendallville: electric and water $36 a night plus tax, $38 on holidays and Apple Festival weekends. Primitive $25 ($28 holidays). Cash or check only. To reserve ahead, one night is paid up front, non-refundable.

fees.source: https://www.kendallvillein.gov/BixlerLakeCampground ('Tent and RV with hook-up (electric & water) $36.00/night + tax'; 'Holidays and Apple Festival weekends with hook-up - $38.00/night + tax'), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://www.kendallvillein.gov/BixlerLakeCampground ('hook-up (electric & water)'; 'Septic dumping - no charge for campers'), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://www.kendallvillein.gov/BixlerLakeCampground ('Showers and restrooms'; 'a camp store offers firewood and ice'; 'Septic dumping'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Opens the last weekend of April, weather permitting, through October.

season.source: https://www.kendallvillein.gov/BixlerLakeCampground ('Opens last weekend of April (weather permitting) thru October'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Campground 260-242-6898 in season, Park and Recreation office 260-347-1064 otherwise. Holidays need advance reservation with a non-refundable deposit. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: City of Kendallville Parks & Rec, Bixler Lake Park (117-acre lake). Hookup sites are east of the camp road; beach and kayak rentals on the lake. --Claude
summary: $36 confirmed, high 36 -> 38 (holiday/Apple Festival); water hookup, facilities, season, phone booking added; note cleaned.
flags: SITES: stored count 103 and max_rig 60 are from old note prose; no city page gives either. The city's map shows about 20 numbered hookup posts with A-D lettered sites (roughly 45-50) and primitive sites #1-19, nowhere near 103 electric. Left as is; suggest checking by phone, 260-242-6898.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' holds for hookup sites. City map puts all hookup sites east of the west camp road, roughly 100-180 m from Bixler Lake through wetland and trees. Primitive #1-9 sit along the wetland edge on the west side of that road, nearest the lake (about 50-100 m) with a wooded wetland between; imagery shows no open line to the water.
AMPS: city page says only 'electrical hookups'; electric left unset. An RV Life reviewer complains of power ('electric not so great').
LONG STAY: monthly $550 for RVs, not a concern for a city campground selling nights; share not stated. Trains noted by a reviewer ('Lots of trains').
PUBLIC: ordinary night bookable by anyone by phone or walk-up. Pin good.
